_schema: preservation-loan-book optional NOAH watch v1.0 (class noah_unregulated). Loaded only with --noah-watch / config noah_watch: true. Scores unregulated 5+ unit properties absent from OHCS/HUD/NHPD as candidates for public acquisition or acquisition-rehab grants, never as a buyer's refinance screen. Only route: nofa_offer (acquisition_grant product). No outreach. See references/noah-watch.md. Weights sum to 100.

factors.name: units_5plus_unregulated

bands.reading: Small unregulated building with no program events: naturally occurring affordable stock the market can reprice at any lease turn.
bands.intervention: preservation_nofa_invitation (acquisition_grant); NOAH OHAF bridge where listed in mandate.json

bands.reading: Twenty or more unregulated units: a public acquisition that would add a whole building to the regulated inventory.

factors.notes: programs_list absent means no OHCS/HUD/NHPD program is attached to the property; a property with any program belongs in affordable_public_am, never here.

factors.name: rent_vs_fmr_gap

bands.reading: In-place rents at or below 85% of FMR / SAFMR: deeply affordable today and most exposed to repricing on sale.
Rents 85-95% of FMR: affordable with a thin margin.

factors.notes: rent_to_fmr_ratio = est_rent / FMR or SAFMR from market-params safmr block (noah_candidates.csv supplies est_rent). No valuation beyond this gap.

bands.reading: One year of unpaid property tax: an owner under operating stress.
Two or more years delinquent: the property could reach the tax-foreclosure list, where the county itself becomes the owner.
Held fifteen or more years: low basis, aging systems, a generational transfer or sale ahead.

bands.intervention: watch; preservation_nofa_invitation when other factors fire

factors.name: maturity

bands.reading: A recorded or reported first-mortgage maturity inside 24 months: the owner must refinance or sell.

factors.notes: RECORDED/REPORTED only; no inferred or proxy maturities in the agency tool.

bands.reading: Open code case on unregulated stock: rehab need the acquisition grant would have to fund.
Dangerous-building listing: life-safety exposure for unprotected tenants.

rules.condition: intervention_score >= 30 AND mandate.json lists an open acquisition_grant product (mandate_fit eligible)

quality_rules: Off by default for every profile; enabled only by --noah-watch or config noah_watch: true (R7).
Only route nofa_offer; no acquisition, assumption or outreach routes; owner_outreach false on every handoff.
No valuation beyond the rent/FMR gap; no refinance-gap screen.
